`enum StateTrap`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.contract` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [StateTrap.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/contract/StateTrap.java)

A state that a host may leave set before a frame of JOID, which [`StateGuardContractSuite`](/reference/testing/stateguardcontractsuite/) sets to check that JOID draws the same anyway.

## Learn more

- [The suites](/build/testing-a-backend/#the-suites)
- [Embedding in a host](/build/embedding-in-a-host/)
